title: Veil and Hollow Revisited
author: Gideon Fairweather
blurb: Paloma Delacroix, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the long winter finishes falling.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
